section_summary.extract_value: This section presents results from a mediation analysis examining the role of ethnic identity (MEIM) in relation to body appreciation (BAS) and eating disorder pathology. Ethnic identity was positively associated with body appreciation and self-esteem, and negatively associated with Western beauty ideal internalization and eating concerns. A bootstrapping mediation analysis tested whether Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, finding no significant indirect effect for body appreciation (95% CI: −.01, .24), but significant mediation effects for eating, shape, and weight concerns.
